answer_1.quote: Text-to-Image (T2I) models have achieved remarkable capabilities in synthesizing high-quality, photorealistic images.

answer_2.quote: We utilize the color and spatial splits from T2I-CompBench, adopting their original metrics (BLIP-VQA and UniDet). We also leverage GenAIBench, ... We employ VQAScore for GenAIBench evaluation.

answer_4.quote: To validate that our improvements reflect genuine quality gains rather than metric exploitation, we conduct comprehensive human evaluations across both models.
answer_4.guideline: We ask three human annotators to rank the images based on the alignment between image and text prompt only.
criteria: alignment between image and text prompt
